# `lakana token`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana token [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage personal access tokens.

## `lakana token issue`

Usage: `lakana token issue [OPTIONS] {principal} {name}`

Issue a personal access token named NAME for PRINCIPAL; the token is shown once.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRINCIPAL` | text | required |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  |

## `lakana token list`

Usage: `lakana token list [OPTIONS] {principal}`

List PRINCIPAL's tokens (never their secrets).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRINCIPAL` | text | required |  |

## `lakana token revoke`

Usage: `lakana token revoke [OPTIONS] {principal} {key_id}`

Revoke PRINCIPAL's token KEY_ID.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRINCIPAL` | text | required |  |
| `KEY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
